annotations.title: What games built like this earn

description: How released Steam games built like a given game (its core mechanics) or carrying given mechanics did: how many there are, the share that reached 1,000 reviews, and those games' median owners and estimated gross revenue. Pass a game, or mechanics in plain words; optionally a price (defaults to the game's own list price; the group is then games priced 0.7x to 1.4x of it).

game.description: A Steam game: its name, store link or app id

mechanics.description: Mechanics in plain words, comma separated, e.g. 'deckbuilding, permadeath'

price.description: List price in US dollars, e.g. '$14.99' or 'free'

name: games_like_this_earn
title: What games built like this earn
